offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures medical countermeasures such as vaccines, antitoxins and overdose antidotes, sold mainly to government stockpiling agencies and healthcare channels. It also runs contract development and manufacturing for other drug makers.

primary_products.value: anthrax vaccine; smallpox vaccine; naloxone nasal spray; botulism antitoxin; anthrax antitoxin

primary_services.value: contract development and manufacturing; biologics fill-finish; process development

customer_segment.value: B2G: US and foreign government stockpile and biodefense agencies, such as BARDA and the Department of Defense; B2B: pharmaceutical companies buying contract manufacturing, wholesalers and pharmacies buying overdose products

end_markets.value: government biodefense; public health; pharmaceutical; healthcare

revenue_model.value: product sales: vaccines, antitoxins and overdose products sold to governments and wholesalers; project or contract: government procurement and development contracts for stockpiled countermeasures; service fees: contract development and manufacturing services for other drug makers; licensing or royalties: royalties on overdose products sold by licensing partners
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes vaccines and antitoxins in its own plants, sold to governments and wholesalers; brand owner: markets overdose nasal spray made with partners, sold to pharmacies and wholesalers; service provider: manufactures biologic drugs for other companies, which supply the drug and pay fees
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; brand owner; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Sells to US federal and state governments and to foreign governments and health agencies worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: biodefense vaccines, antitoxins and antidotes, and contract manufacturing for drug makers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct government contracts and sales to national stockpile agencies; distributors / dealers: wholesalers that supply overdose products to pharmacies; third-party retail: pharmacies and retailers selling the overdose nasal spray over the counter
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: high: vaccines and drugs need FDA approval and licenses, manufacturing under FDA good manufacturing rules
